pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: join ANC visits and livelihoods by district and year, 2023 ANC and employment rates side by side
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: SELECT a.district, a.year, a.pregnancies_registered, a.anc4_completed, CAST(a.pregnancies_registered AS REAL) / NULLIF(NULLIF(a.pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) * 100 AS anc4_completion_rate, l.women_enrolled, l.employed_at_6_months, CAST(l.women_enrolled AS REAL) / NULLIF(NULLIF(l.women_enrolled, 0), 0) * 100 AS employment_rate FROM anc_visits AS a JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 AND a.source = 'synthetic Bihar ANC fixture' AND l.source = 'synthetic women livelihood outcomes fixture'

attempts.response:
SELECT
    a.district,
    a.year,
    a.pregnancies_registered,
    a.anc4_completed,
    a.pregnancies_registered::FLOAT / NULLIF(a.pregnancies_registered,0) * 100 AS anc4_completion_rate,
    l.women_enrolled,
    l.employed_at_6_months,
    l.women_enrolled::FLOAT / NULLIF(l.women_enrolled,0) * 100 AS employment_rate
FROM
    anc_visits a
JOIN
    livelihoods l
    ON a.district = l.district
    AND a.year = l.year
WHERE
    a.year = 2023
    AND a.source = 'synthetic Bihar ANC fixture'
    AND l.source = 'synthetic women livelihood outcomes fixture';
